ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓمٓ
en: (1) Alif, Lām, Meem.[1138]
tr: Alif lām mīm

ar: غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ
en: (2) The Byzantines have been defeated[1139]
tr: Ghulibatir-rūm

ar: فِىٓ أَدْنَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ
en: (3) In the nearest land.[1140] But they, after their defeat, will overcome
enNotes: [1140]- Another meaning is "in the lowest land."
tr: Fī adnal-arḍi wahum mim baʿdi ghalabihim sayaghlibūn

ar: فِى بِضْعِ سِنِينَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِنۢ بَعْدُ وَيَوْمَئِذٍ يَفْرَحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (4) Within three to nine years. To Allāh belongs the command [i.e., decree] before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice
tr: Fī biḍʿi sinīn, lillāhil-amru min qablu wamim baʿd, wayawmaʾidhiy yafraḥul-muʾminūn

ar: بِنَصْرِ ٱللَّهِ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
en: (5) In the victory of Allāh.[1141] He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
enNotes: [1141]- i.e., the victory given by Allāh to a people of the Scripture (Christians) over the Magians of Persia.
tr: Binaṣrillāh, yanṣuru may yashāʾ, wahuwal-ʿazīzur-raḥīm

ar: وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (6) [It is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know.
tr: Waʿdallāh, lā yukhlifullāhu waʿdahū walākinna aktharan-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn

ar: يَعْلَمُونَ ظَٰهِرًا مِّنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
en: (7) They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.
tr: Yaʿlamūna ẓāhiram minal-ḥayātid-dunyā, wahum ʿanil-ākhirati hum ghāfilūn

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم مَّا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَٰفِرُونَ
en: (8) Do they not contemplate within themselves?[1142] Allāh has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers.
enNotes: [1142]- An additional meaning is "Do they not contemplate concerning themselves."
tr: Awalam yatafakkarū fī anfusihim, mā khalaqallāhus-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqqi waʾajalim musammā, waʾinna kathīram minan-nāsi biliqāʾi rabbihim lakāfirūn

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ كَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَثَارُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
en: (9) Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed [or excavated] the earth and built it up more than they [i.e., the Makkans] have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allāh would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.
tr: Awalam yasīrū fil-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatul-ladhīna min qablihim, kānū ashadda minhum quwwataw waʾathārul-arḍa waʿamarūhā akthara mimmā ʿamarūhā wajāʾathum rusuluhum bil-bayyināt, famā kānallāhu liyaẓlimahum walākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn

ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُوا۟ بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: (10) Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of Allāh and used to ridicule them.
tr: Thumma kāna ʿāqibatal-ladhīna asāʾus-sūʾā an kadhdhabū biʾāyātillāhi wakānū bihā yastahziʾūn

ar: ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
en: (11) Allāh begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.
tr: Allāhu yabdaʾul-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhū thumma ilayhi turjaʿūn

ar: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
en: (12) And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.
tr: Wayawma taqūmus-sāʿatu yublisul-mujrimūn

ar: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمْ شُفَعَٰٓؤُا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ كَٰفِرِينَ
en: (13) And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.
tr: Walam yakul lahum min shurakāʾihim shufaʿāʾu wakānū bishurakāʾihim kāfirīn

ar: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ
en: (14) And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.
tr: Wayawma taqūmus-sāʿatu yawmaʾidhiy yatafarraqūn

ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍ يُحْبَرُونَ
en: (15) And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.
tr: Faʾammal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fahum fī rawḍatiy yuḥbarūn

ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
en: (16) But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
tr: Waʾammal-ladhīna kafarū wakadhdhabū biʾāyātinā waliqāʾil-ākhirati faʾulāʾika fil-ʿadhābi muḥḍarūn

ar: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
en: (17) So exalted is Allāh when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.
tr: Fasubḥānallāhi ḥīna tumsūna waḥīna tuṣbiḥūn

ar: وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ
en: (18) And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.
tr: Walahul-ḥamdu fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi waʿashiyyaw waḥīna tuẓhirūn

ar: يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَيُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
en: (19) He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.[1143]
enNotes: [1143]- Of the graves or out of the earth at the time of resurrection.
tr: Yukhrijul-ḥayya minal-mayyiti wayukhrijul-mayyita minal-ḥayyi wayuḥyil-arḍa baʿda mawtihā, wakadhālika tukhrajūn

ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٌ تَنتَشِرُونَ
en: (20) And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].
tr: Wamin āyātihī an khalaqakum min turābin thumma idhā antum basharun tantashirūn

ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
en: (21) And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
tr: Wamin āyātihī an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwājal litaskunū ilayhā wajaʿala baynakum mawaddataw waraḥmah, inna fī dhālika laʾāyātil liqawmiy yatafakkarūn

ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّلْعَٰلِمِينَ
en: (22) And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.
tr: Wamin āyātihī khalqus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wakhtilāfu alsinatikum waʾalwānikum, inna fī dhālika laʾāyātil lil-ʿālimīn

ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبْتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
en: (23) And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
tr: Wamin āyātihī manāmukum bil-layli wan-nahāri wabtighāʾukum min faḍlih, inna fī dhālika laʾāyātil liqawmiy yasmaʿūn

ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَيُحْىِۦ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
en: (24) And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.
tr: Wamin āyātihī yurīkumul-barqa khawfaw waṭamaʿaw wayunazzilu minas-samāʾi māʾan fayuḥyī bihil-arḍa baʿda mawtihā, inna fī dhālika laʾāyātil liqawmiy yaʿqilūn

ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ
en: (25) And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand [i.e., remain] by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.
tr: Wamin āyātihī an taqūmas-samāʾu wal-arḍu biʾamrih, thumma idhā daʿākum daʿwah, minal-arḍi idhā antum takhrujūn

ar: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَٰنِتُونَ
en: (26) And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient.
tr: Walahū man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ, kullul lahū qānitūn

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَهُ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
en: (27) And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description [i.e., attribute] in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Wahuwal-ladhī yabdaʾul-khalqa thumma yuʿīduhū wahuwa ahwanu ʿalayh, walahul-mathalul-aʿlā fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wahuwal-ʿazīzul-ḥakīm

ar: ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُكُم مِّن شُرَكَآءَ فِى مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ فَأَنتُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
en: (28) He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess [i.e., slaves] any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]?[1144] Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.
tr: Ḍaraba lakum mathalam min anfusikum, hal lakum mim mā malakat aymānukum min shurakāʾa fī mā razaqnākum faʾantum fīhi sawāʾun takhāfūnahum kakhīfatikum anfusakum, kadhālika nufaṣṣilul-āyāti liqawmiy yaʿqilūn

ar: بَلِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ فَمَن يَهْدِى مَنْ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
en: (29) But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allāh has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.
tr: Balittabaʿal-ladhīna ẓalamū ahwāʾahum bighayri ʿilm, famay yahdī man aḍallallāh, wamā lahum min nāṣirīn

ar: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا فِطْرَتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ ٱللَّهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (30) So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fiṭrah[1145] of Allāh upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allāh.[1146] That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.
enNotes:
[1145]- The natural inborn inclination of man to worship his Creator prior to the corruption of his nature by external influences. Thus, Islāmic monotheism is described as the religion of fiṭrah - that of the inherent nature of mankind.
[1146]- i.e., let people remain true to their fiṭrah within the religion of Islām.
tr: Faʾaqim wajhaka lid-dīni ḥanīfā, fiṭratallāhil-latī faṭaran-nāsa ʿalayhā, lā tabdīla likhalqillāh, dhālikad-dīnul-qayyimu walākinna aktharan-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn

ar: مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
en: (31) [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allāh
tr: Munībīna ilayhi wattaqūhu waʾaqīmuṣ-ṣalāta walā takūnū minal-mushrikīn

ar: مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ شِيَعًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
en: (32) [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.[1147]
tr: Minal-ladhīna farraqū dīnahum wakānū shiyaʿā, kullu ḥizbim bimā ladayhim fariḥūn

ar: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا۟ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
en: (33) And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,
tr: Waʾidhā massan-nāsa ḍurrun daʿaw rabbahum munībīna ilayhi thumma idhā adhāqahum minhu raḥmatan idhā farīqum minhum birabbihim yushrikūn

ar: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (34) So that they will deny what We have granted them.[1148] Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
enNotes: [1148]- Or "So let them deny what We have granted them."
tr: Liyakfurū bimā ātaynāhum, fatamattaʿū, fasawfa taʿlamūn

ar: أَمْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يُشْرِكُونَ
en: (35) Or have We sent down to them an authority [i.e., a proof or scripture], and it speaks of what they have been associating with Him?
tr: Am anzalnā ʿalayhim sulṭānan fahuwa yatakallamu bimā kānū bihī yushrikūn

ar: وَإِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوا۟ بِهَا وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ
en: (36) And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.
tr: Waʾidhā adhaqnan-nāsa raḥmatan fariḥū bihā, waʾin tuṣibhum sayyiʾatum bimā qaddamat aydīhim idhā hum yaqnaṭūn

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (37) Do they not see that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
tr: Awalam yaraw annallāha yabsuṭur-rizqa limay yashāʾu wayaqdir, inna fī dhālika laʾāyātil liqawmiy yuʾminūn

ar: فَـَٔاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
en: (38) So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh, and it is they who will be the successful.
tr: Faʾāti dhal-qurbā ḥaqqahū wal-miskīna wabnas-sabīl, dhālika khayrul lilladhīna yurīdūna wajhallāh, waʾulāʾika humul-mufliḥūn

ar: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن رِّبًا لِّيَرْبُوَا۟ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٍ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُضْعِفُونَ
en: (39) And whatever you give for interest [i.e., advantage] to increase within the wealth of people[1149] will not increase with Allāh. But what you give in zakāh,[1150] desiring the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh - those are the multipliers.[1151]
enNotes:
[1149]- The phrase includes several connotations, among them: a) that which is given as usury or interest, b) that which is given on the condition that it be repaid with interest, and c) a gift given with the intention of obtaining from the recipient greater benefit or a larger gift.
[1150]- The meaning of ṣadaqah (voluntary charity) is included here.
[1151]- Of their blessings on earth and their rewards in the Hereafter.
tr: Wamā ātaytum mir ribal liyarbuwa fī amwālin-nāsi falā yarbū ʿindallāh, wamā ātaytum min zakātin turīdūna wajhallāhi faʾulāʾika humul-muḍʿifūn

ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَفْعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَىْءٍ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
en: (40) Allāh is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
tr: Allāhul-ladhī khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥyīkum, hal min shurakāʾikum may yafʿalu min dhālikum min shayʾ, subḥānahū wataʿālā ʿammā yushrikūn

ar: ظَهَرَ ٱلْفَسَادُ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِى ٱلنَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
en: (41) Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He [i.e., Allāh] may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].
tr: Ẓaharal-fasādu fil-barri wal-baḥri bimā kasabat aydin-nāsi liyudhīqahum baʿḍal-ladhī ʿamilū laʿallahum yarjiʿūn

ar: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلُ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّشْرِكِينَ
en: (42) Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allāh].
tr: Qul sīrū fil-arḍi fanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatul-ladhīna min qabl, kāna aktharuhum mushrikīn

ar: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ
en: (43) So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.[1152]
enNotes: [1152]- Into those destined for Paradise and those destined for Hell.
tr: Faʾaqim wajhaka lid-dīnil-qayyimi min qabli ay yaʾtiya yawmul lā maradda lahū minallāhi yawmaʾidhiy yaṣṣaddaʿūn

ar: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ
en: (44) Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,
tr: Man kafara faʿalayhi kufruh, waman ʿamila ṣāliḥan faliʾanfusihim yamhadūn

ar: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (45) That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers.
tr: Liyajziyal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti min faḍlih, innahū lā yuḥibbul-kāfirīn

ar: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَن يُرْسِلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَلِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
en: (46) And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy [i.e., rain] and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful.
tr: Wamin āyātihī ay yursilar-riyāḥa mubashshirātiw waliyudhīqakum mir raḥmatihī walitajriyal-fulku biʾamrihī walitabtaghū min faḍlihī walaʿallakum tashkurūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (47) And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support[1153] of the believers.
enNotes: [1153]- i.e., aid or the bestowal of victory.
tr: Walaqad arsalnā min qablika rusulan ilā qawmihim fajāʾūhum bil-bayyināti fantaqamnā minal-ladhīna ajramū, wakāna ḥaqqā, ʿalaynā naṣrul-muʾminīn

ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهُۥ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُۥ كِسَفًا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَٰلِهِۦ فَإِذَآ أَصَابَ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
en: (48) It is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice
tr: Allāhul-ladhī yursilur-riyāḥa fatuthīru saḥāban fayabsuṭuhū fis-samāʾi kayfa yashāʾu wayajʿaluhū kisafan fataral-wadqa yakhruju min khilālih, faʾidhā aṣāba bihī may yashāʾu min ʿibādihī idhā hum yastabshirūn

ar: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمُبْلِسِينَ
en: (49) Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.
tr: Waʾin kānū min qabli ay yunazzala ʿalayhim min qablihī lamublisīn

ar: فَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِ رَحْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
en: (50) So observe the effects of the mercy of Allāh - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
tr: Fanẓur ilā āthāri raḥmatillāhi kayfa yuḥyil-arḍa baʿda mawtihā, inna dhālika lamuḥyil-mawtā, wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr

ar: وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ يَكْفُرُونَ
en: (51) But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.[1154]
enNotes: [1154]- Denying and ungrateful for the previous favors of Allāh.
tr: Walaʾin arsalnā rīḥan faraʾawhu muṣfarral laẓallū mim baʿdihī yakfurūn

ar: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
en: (52) So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.
tr: Faʾinnaka lā tusmiʿul-mawtā walā tusmiʿuṣ-ṣummad-duʿāʾa idhā wallaw mudbirīn

ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَٰدِ ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَٰلَتِهِمْ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
en: (53) And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
tr: Wamā anta bihādil-ʿumyi ʿan ḍalālatihim, in tusmiʿu illā may yuʾminu biʾāyātinā fahum muslimūn

ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ
en: (54) Allāh is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.
tr: Allāhul-ladhī khalaqakum min ḍaʿfin thumma jaʿala mim baʿdi ḍaʿfin quwwatan thumma jaʿala mim baʿdi quwwatin ḍaʿfaw washaybah, yakhluqu mā yashāʾ, wahuwal-ʿalīmul-qadīr

ar: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْفَكُونَ
en: (55) And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.
tr: Wayawma taqūmus-sāʿatu yuqsimul-mujrimūna mā labithū ghayra sāʿah, kadhālika kānū yuʾfakūn

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَٱلْإِيمَٰنَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْبَعْثِ فَهَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْبَعْثِ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
en: (56) But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allāh's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."[1155]
tr: Waqālal-ladhīna ūtul-ʿilma wal-īmāna laqad labithtum fī kitābillāhi ilā yawmil-baʿth, fahādhā yawmul-baʿthi walākinnakum kuntum lā taʿlamūn

ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
en: (57) So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
tr: Fayawmaʾidhil lā yanfaʿul-ladhīna ẓalamū maʿdhiratuhum walā hum yustaʿtabūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ وَلَئِن جِئْتَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍ لَّيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ
en: (58) And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muḥammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers."
tr: Walaqad ḍarabnā lin-nāsi fī hādhal-qurʾāni min kulli mathal, walaʾin jiʾtahum biʾāyatil layaqūlannal-ladhīna kafarū in antum illā mubṭilūn

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (59) Thus does Allāh seal the hearts of those who do not know.[1156]
enNotes: [1156]- i.e., those who do not wish to know the truth and refuse it.
tr: Kadhālika yaṭbaʿullāhu ʿalā qulūbil-ladhīna lā yaʿlamūn

ar: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
en: (60) So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].
tr: Faṣbir inna waʿdallāhi ḥaqquw walā yastakhiffannakal-ladhīna lā yūqinūn
